name: MoveFileNode
label: Move File(s)
description: Moves one or more files into a destination folder. Supports wildcard patterns and multiple paths separated by semicolons.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SourceFiles
fields.label: Source file path(s)
fields.description: One or more file paths to move, separated by semicolons. Supports wildcards (e.g., 'C:\Inbox\*.pdf;C:\Inbox\report.docx').

fields.name: DestinationFolder
fields.label: Destination folder
fields.description: The folder where files will be moved to (e.g., 'C:\Archive\Reports'). Created automatically if it does not exist.

fields.name: IfExistsAction
fields.label: If file exists
fields.description: Action to take when a file with the same name already exists in the destination. Default: Do nothing (skip).

selectOptions.label: Do nothing
selectOptions.description: Skips the file if it already exists.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Deletes the existing file and moves the new file.

fields.name: MovedFiles
fields.label: Moved files
fields.description: Returns the list of full paths of all successfully moved files in the destination folder.
